scope: Export range, tail, channel and format choices for general projects
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0), docker --network none
verified_behaviors: Header fields (format code, bits, channels, rate, block align, byte rate, RIFF/data sizes) for stereo PCM16, mono PCM24 and stereo float32
Bar 2 plus a 100 ms tail matches independent per-track renders: within 1 LSB for PCM, exact for float; the tail is silence after every track stops
Mono equals (L+R)/2 of the stereo export for a hard-panned, partly muted mix
Unsaved tempo edit is exported; eight invalid option sets are refused with no destination or partial file
Start bar 256 at 300 BPM exports exactly one bar
Options set through the actual QML (keyboard on spin boxes, combo selections) produce a mono 24-bit file of the declared length
limits: 48 kHz only, WAV only; tails are silent until effects exist. Offscreen checks.
